links.outcome: ChatGPT primary diagnosis accuracy on ophthalmic cases; hallucination of non-user-provided data
links.effect: ChatGPT correctly identified the primary diagnosis in 15 of 17 (88.2%) cases; two cases excluded due to hallucinations or fabrications of nonuser-provided data.
links.quote: Overall, ChatGPT correctly identified the primary diagnosis in 15 of 17 (88.2%) cases.

screen.reason: Empirical reader/evaluation study assessing ChatGPT's performance on ophthalmic clinical case studies and clinician ability to distinguish AI vs. human responses, without evaluating a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
